fileNodes.name: CLAUDE.md
fileNodes.summary: Guidance document for Claude Code explaining that FixUp Arena is a single static index.html landing page with no build step, describing its view-switching, 3D background, and scroll-animation architecture, and directing questions to the graphify knowledge graph first.

fileNodes.name: index.html
fileNodes.summary: The entire FixUp Arena marketing/landing page — a single static HTML file combining Tailwind-styled markup for four faux 'views' (home, privacy, terms, support), a Three.js particle background, GSAP/ScrollTrigger scroll animations, and vanilla JS hash-based client-side navigation, with Stripe Payment Links for registration.
